note: Majority, read 2026-11-03 through TanzLII's search, which returns the sections' text (its document pages sit behind a Cloudflare check): the Age of Majority Act [Cap. 43], s. 2: full age at the beginning of the eighteenth anniversary of birth (s. 3 keeps twenty-one where another Act prescribes it, not held). Work: 14. The Law of the Child Act [Cap. 13, Revised Edition of 2019], read 2026-11-03 in full in the PDF the Ministry of Community Development, Gender, Women and Special Groups serves (jamii.go.tz; the Attorney General's revised edition of 30 November 2019): s. 77(2), the minimum age for employment or engagement of a child is fourteen, and a child has a right to light work; the Employment and Labour Relations Act [Cap. 366], s. 5(1), read earlier through TanzLII's search, bars employing a child under fourteen too. Performers: barred. Neither Act names a permit or an exception for a performer (a reading); s. 82(3)(f) makes work in bars, hotels and places of entertainment hazardous and unlawful for anyone under eighteen, s. 158(1)(b) bars using a child in a wedding, fashion or similar show at night, s. 78(3)(b) holds more than six hours a day exploitative and s. 79 bars night work from 20:00 to 06:00, none of them held by the form. Service: not read (the game doesn't read service). Until 2026-11-03 TanzLII's search was cited as primary for the Age of Majority Act; it is a legal information institute's copy of the law, so secondary since the ruling of 2026-11-03, so it was relabelled, naming the Parliament of Tanzania's site; a web search for the Act on a government site found none. The entry keeps the Ministry's Law of the Child Act as its primary; majority rests on the secondary copy.

sources.title: Age of Majority Act [Cap. 43], s. 2, revised to 31 December 2023 (TanzLII; its search returns the section, the document page /en/akn/tz/act/ord/1960/33/eng@2023-12-31 sitting behind a Cloudflare check)
sources.said: A person domiciled in Tanzania shall attain full age and cease to be under any disability ... of minority at the beginning of the eighteenth anniversary of the day on which he [was born]

sources.title: The Law of the Child Act, Chapter 13, Revised Edition of 2019 (Government Printer, Dar es Salaam), as served by the Ministry of Community Development, Gender, Women and Special Groups (jamii.go.tz)
sources.said: 77.-(1) A child shall have a right to light work. (2) For the purposes of subsection (1), the minimum age for employment or engagement of a child shall be fourteen years. ... 78.-(3) Labour shall be construed as exploitative if - ... (b) it exceeds six hours a day; ... 79.-(2) "Night work" shall be construed to constitute work performance of which requires the child to be at work between the hours of twenty hours in the evening and six o'clock in the morning. ... 82.-(3) ... hazardous work include- ... (f) work in place such as bars, hotels and places of entertainment. ... 158.-(1) No person shall- ... (b) use a child in a wedding show, fashion show or any other similar shows performed during the night
